# measuringreligiouschange

measuringreligiouschange is a package developed by Center for Advanced
Studies of Population And Religion for Pew Research Center designed to
create religious structure projections. It calculates 4 demographic
processes: - fertility - mortality - switching - migration

For fertility differences it uses calculated differentials which can be
subject to convergence.

## Vignettes

| Vignette | Description |
|----|----|
| [`vignette("conducting-projections")`](articles/conducting-projections.md) | Create a country list, assemble and run a projection, export results to CSV |
| [`vignette("visualising-projections")`](articles/visualising-projections.md) | Save country- and region-level plots; compare two scenarios side-by-side |
| [`vignette("exporting-results")`](articles/exporting-results.md) | Column-by-column description of every CSV output file |
| [`vignette("inner-workings")`](articles/inner-workings.md) | Internal architecture, class field reference, and projection flow diagrams |

## Installation

You can install the latest version of measuringreligiouschange from
GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("CASPAR-PL/measuringreligiouschange")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to create and run a
projection:

``` r

library(measuringreligiouschange)
cl  <- create_country_list(post_switch = FALSE)
obj <- variants_loader(create_projection_object(
  name        = "MRC Projection",
  cl,
  steps       = 5L,
  migration   = FALSE,
  post_switch = FALSE
))
project(obj, progress_bar = FALSE)
```

Additionally it exports all data into .csv files and creates plots for
each country:

``` r

save_csv_all(obj)
save_plots_all(obj)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`base_data_list`](base_data_list.md) : default data list
- [`base_object_generator()`](base_object_generator.md) : Generate main
  Pew scenarios
- [`Country_object-class`](Country_object-class.md)
  [`Country_object`](Country_object-class.md) : Reference Class
  representing a country as Country_object
- [`create_country_list()`](create_country_list.md) : Loading data and
  creating list of Country_objects
- [`create_projection_object()`](create_projection_object.md) : Creating
  projection_object
- [`create_region_list()`](create_region_list.md) : Creating list of
  Region_objects
- [`data_asfr`](data_asfr.md) : Age-Specific Fertility Rates dataset
- [`data_births_ratio`](data_births_ratio.md) : Sex ratio at birth
  dataset
- [`data_fertility_differentials`](data_fertility_differentials.md) :
  Fertility differentials dataset
- [`data_migration_destination`](data_migration_destination.md) :
  Migration destination matrices dataset.
- [`data_migration_rates`](data_migration_rates.md) : Out-migration
  rates dataset
- [`data_population`](data_population.md) : Population dataset
- [`data_regions`](data_regions.md) : Regions dataset
- [`data_structure`](data_structure.md) : Population structure dataset
- [`data_survivability`](data_survivability.md) : Survival rates (nSx)
  dataset
- [`data_switching`](data_switching.md) : religion switching dataset
- [`info_variants`](info_variants.md) : Scenario variants settings
  dataset
- [`project()`](project.md) : Conducting MRC projection
- [`Projection_object-class`](Projection_object-class.md)
  [`Projection_object`](Projection_object-class.md) : A reference class
  containing data and parameters needed for projection.
- [`Region_object-class`](Region_object-class.md)
  [`Region_object`](Region_object-class.md) : Reference Class
  representing a region as Region_object
- [`save_csv_all()`](save_csv_all.md) : Saving projection results to CSV
  files
- [`save_plots_all()`](save_plots_all.md) : Creating and saving
  projection results plots to PDF files
- [`save_plots_comparative_all()`](save_plots_comparative_all.md) :
  Saving country comparative plots to .pdf file(s)
- [`save_plots_comparative_regions_all()`](save_plots_comparative_regions_all.md)
  : Saving region comparative plots to .pdf file(s)
- [`save_plots_regions_all()`](save_plots_regions_all.md) : Creating and
  saving region projection results plots to PDF files
- [`test_object_generator()`](test_object_generator.md) : Generate a
  3-country test projection
- [`variants_loader()`](variants_loader.md) : Calculate variant and
  create modified country_list_object
